description: This PHP class 'UploadState' models and manages the state of a multipart upload in AWS SDK, including tracking uploaded parts, upload status, and related parameters.

classes.name: UploadState
classes.description: Represents and manages the state of a multipart upload, including tracking uploaded parts and upload status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the upload state with a given ID array.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the upload's ID, a tuple of parameters.

methods.name: setUploadId
methods.description: Sets a specific part of the upload ID, typically after initiation.

methods.name: getPartSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of each upload part.

methods.name: setPartSize
methods.description: Sets the size of each upload part.

methods.name: markPartAsUploaded
methods.description: Marks a specific part as uploaded, storing its data.

methods.name: hasPartBeenUploaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific part has been uploaded.

methods.name: getUploadedParts
methods.description: Returns all uploaded parts in sorted order.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the upload (CREATED, INITIATED, COMPLETED).

methods.name: isInitiated
methods.description: Checks if the upload is in the INITIATED state.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the upload is in the COMPLETED state.
